key_insight: HGASurv combines multi-scale pathology features, genomic signatures, and clinical similarity to improve multimodal survival prediction.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support cancer risk stratification, but the abstract does not establish readiness for clinical use.
method: Encode whole-slide image patches at patch, local-neighborhood, and regional scales using spatial coordinates.
Use genomic signatures to query multi-scale image features through cross-modal co-attention.
Propagate fused image–genomic features across a patient graph defined by clinical similarity.
evidence_signal: Across three TCGA cohorts, HGASurv reported the strongest overall C-index performance among evaluated methods, with ablations supporting both proposed modules.
watch_item: The abstract reports no external validation, leaving generalizability beyond the evaluated TCGA cohorts uncertain.
paper_title: HGASurv: Hierarchical Granularity-Aware Integration for Multimodal Survival Prediction
